dedupe_keys.name: slovak household active and reactive electricity measurements 2016

description: This deposit contains fifteen-minute electricity measurements for one thousand anonymized urban and rural households in Slovakia during 2016. A local distribution operator supplied smart-meter observations from homes connected to a 0.4-kilovolt network, and the Slovak University of Technology prepared the public collection. Mendeley version 2 lists one JSON measurement file per household and a CSV meter-information file, freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. Active and reactive measurements are accompanied by postal-code and reserved-capacity information. The title refers to power while the description refers to energy, so units and interval conventions must be checked before network calculations. Coverage is one year and the selected operator sample, not all Slovak households or present-day demand. A reviewer-assessed use is constructing residential load and reactive-power scenarios for distribution simulations. model-pandapower is a related network tool. No household data were downloaded, and no feeder topology or automated import was established.
name: Slovak household active and reactive electricity measurements, 2016
